scholarships.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
scholarships.amountSubtitle: 100% course fee reimbursement + monthly maintenance allowance
scholarships.domicileRequirement: All notified Indian States & Union Territories
keyBenefits: Full course-fee reimbursement at sanctioned government ceiling rates
Monthly maintenance allowance for hostellers (₹1,200/mo) and day scholars (₹550/mo)
Special book & equipment allowance for PVTG scholars
Renewable every academic year until course completion
eligibilityCriteria: Candidate must belong to a notified Scheduled Tribe (ST) or PVTG community
Must be enrolled in a recognized post-matriculation institution or university
Total annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2.50 Lakh
Student must have a valid Aadhaar-seeded bank account for DBT
requiredDocuments: Caste / ST Certificate issued by Competent Authority
Annual Income Certificate for current financial year
Bonafide / Admission letter from registered institution
scholarships.selectionMethod: Entitlement-based for all eligible applicants meeting criteria
scholarships.disbursementMode: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) via PFMS to Aadhaar Seeded Bank Account
scholarships.applicationProcedure: Apply online on National Scholarship Portal (NSP) with One-Time Registration (OTR). Institutional Nodal Officer (INO) and State Nodal Officer (SNO) verify online.

faqs.q: Can a student availing PMS-ST receive another scholarship?
faqs.a: No. As per MoTA guidelines, a student holding PMS-ST cannot hold another central or state scholarship concurrently.
Yes, an Aadhaar number and Aadhaar-seeded general savings bank account are required for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

faqs.q: How does renewal work for subsequent years?
faqs.a: The scholarship is renewed automatically upon uploading the annual promotion mark sheet and bonafide certificate verified by the institute head.

scholarships.name: National Top-Class Education Scholarship for ST Students
scholarships.targetGroup: Scheduled Tribe (ST) students in notified premier institutions (IITs, NITs, IIMs, AIIMS, BIT Mesra, NLUs)
scholarships.amountSubtitle: Full tuition fee + ₹45,000 laptop grant + ₹3,000/yr book grant
keyBenefits: Full tuition fee and non-refundable charges reimbursement (up to ₹2.5 Lakh/yr in private, actuals in govt)
Living allowance of ₹3,000 per month (₹36,000/year)
Books and stationery allowance of ₹3,000 per year
One-time computer/laptop grant of ₹45,000 with accessories
eligibilityCriteria: Must be a Scheduled Tribe (ST) student
Must have secured admission in notified institutes of excellence (IIT, NIT, IIM, BIT Mesra, etc.)
Total family income from all sources must not exceed ₹6.00 Lakh per annum
Must not be in receipt of any other scholarship or stipend
requiredDocuments: ST Caste Certificate from Revenue Authority
Income Certificate issued by Tehsildar / SDO
Admission allotment letter & Fee Receipt from premier institute
Aadhaar card and bank account proof
scholarships.selectionMethod: Merit list generated among admitted ST students within the allocated institutional quota
scholarships.disbursementMode: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to student account for allowances; institutional fee disbursed directly or reimbursed
scholarships.applicationProcedure: Submit fresh application online at scholarships.gov.in (NSP) selecting MoTA - Top Class Education Scheme.

faqs.q: Which institutes are covered under Top Class ST?
faqs.a: Top 250+ notified premier institutes across India including all IITs, NITs, IIMs, IISc, AIIMS, BIT Mesra, National Law Universities, and premier design schools.

faqs.q: Is there a laptop grant provided?
faqs.a: Yes, a one-time grant of ₹45,000 is sanctioned to first-year admitted students for laptop/computer purchase.

scholarships.name: National Fellowship for Higher Education of ST Students
scholarships.targetGroup: ST scholars pursuing regular full-time M.Phil and Ph.D degrees
keyBenefits: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF): ₹37,000/month for initial 2 years
Senior Research Fellowship (SRF): ₹42,000/month for remaining 3 years
Contingency grant: ₹10,000 - ₹25,000 per annum depending on stream (Humanities/Sciences)
Escorts / Reader assistance allowance of ₹2,000/mo for divyangjan scholars
eligibilityCriteria: Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidate registered for regular full-time M.Phil/Ph.D in a UGC-recognized university
Annual family income ceiling of ₹6.00 Lakh
Must not be employed or drawing salary/fellowship from any other funding agency
requiredDocuments: University M.Phil / Ph.D registration / joining report
Master degree marksheet and degree certificate
scholarships.selectionMethod: National merit list based on Post-Graduate marks and research admission
scholarships.disbursementMode: Direct monthly credit via Canara Bank Scholarship & Fellowship Management Portal (SFMP)
scholarships.applicationProcedure: Online registration on the MoTA Fellowship portal with verified university supervisor credentials.

faqs.q: What is the maximum duration of NFST?
faqs.a: Maximum 5 years for integrated M.Phil + Ph.D or direct Ph.D research.

scholarships.name: National Overseas Scholarship for ST Students
scholarships.targetGroup: ST students securing admission in top foreign universities (QS/THE top 500)
scholarships.amountSubtitle: Full foreign tuition + US$15,400 annual living allowance + return airfare
keyBenefits: 100% full international tuition fee payment directly to foreign institution
Annual living allowance: US$ 15,400 (or £9,900 for UK)
Contingency allowance for books, research materials, study tours: US$ 1,500/yr
Economy class return flight ticket from India to destination country
Mandatory medical insurance coverage and visa fees reimbursement
eligibilityCriteria: Must belong to a notified Scheduled Tribe (ST) community
Unconditional admission offer letter from a foreign university ranked in Top 500 QS world rankings
Minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA in Bachelor / Master degree
Total annual family income must not exceed ₹6.80 Lakh
Age limit: Below 35 years as of 1st July of the application year
requiredDocuments: ST Community Certificate issued by designated District Authority
Unconditional Offer Letter from overseas University with QS ranking proof
GRE / GMAT / IELTS / TOEFL scorecard (if required by institution)
Degree certificates and complete academic transcripts
scholarships.selectionMethod: Central Selection Committee interview & ranking based on university QS rank and student academic merit
scholarships.disbursementMode: Direct wire transfer to overseas university for tuition fees and quarterly maintenance allowance into international bank account
scholarships.applicationProcedure: Online application on overseas.tribal.gov.in with unconditional admission confirmation.

faqs.q: Can PVTG candidates apply with priority?
faqs.a: Yes, MoTA guidelines reserve specific slots and give priority considerations to candidates from Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs).
Work experience is preferable for Master’s candidates and advantageous for Ph.D. proposals, but not strictly mandatory if academic record is exceptional.

scholarships.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Degree)
scholarships.targetGroup: Girl students admitted to 1st year Degree or 2nd year Lateral Entry in AICTE-approved institutions
scholarships.amountSubtitle: Lump-sum grant towards college fee, computer, books & equipment
keyBenefits: ₹50,000 per annum for each year of study (up to 4 years for 1st year admits, 3 years for lateral entry)
Single lump-sum payment towards tuition fee, computer purchase, software, stationeries, and books
All eligible girl applicants from 13 Union Territories & North Eastern States receive 100% scholarships without state quota caps
eligibilityCriteria: Only female students are eligible
Admitted to 1st year B.E./B.Tech/B.Pharm or 2nd year through Lateral Entry in an AICTE-approved institution
Maximum two girl children per family eligible
Family income from all sources must not exceed ₹8.00 Lakh per annum
Must NOT be a recipient of any other central, state or AICTE sponsored scholarship
requiredDocuments: AICTE institute admission letter & bonafide certificate (Appendix-I)
Annual Family Income Certificate issued by Tehsildar/BDO (Appendix-II)
Parent Declaration certifying max two daughters availing facility (Appendix-III)
Aadhaar card and Aadhaar-seeded saving bank account
scholarships.selectionMethod: Pure merit based on percentage of marks in 10+2 / qualifying examination across State/UT quotas (5,000 total scholarships nationwide)
scholarships.disbursementMode: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into the student’s general savings bank account
scholarships.applicationProcedure: Online submission on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). Host institution verifies, followed by State Directorate of Technical Education (DTE).

faqs.q: I am a 3rd year degree student, can I apply for Pragati?
faqs.a: No. Only first-year admitted degree students or second-year lateral entry students are eligible to apply for fresh Pragati scholarships.

faqs.q: Can both daughters in a family receive Pragati?
faqs.a: Yes, up to two girls per family are explicitly eligible to receive the Pragati scholarship concurrently.

faqs.q: Can SC/ST/OBC students apply for Pragati?
faqs.a: Yes, reservation is applied as per Government of India norms (15% SC, 7.5% ST, 27% OBC) with vacant slots transferring to general merit.

scholarships.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Diploma)
scholarships.targetGroup: Girl students admitted to 1st year or 2nd year lateral entry in polytechnic diploma courses
scholarships.amountSubtitle: Lump-sum grant towards polytechnic fee, stationery, equipment
keyBenefits: ₹50,000 per annum (maximum 3 years for first year diploma, 2 years for lateral entry)
Lump-sum allowance for college fee, computer, software, and tools
eligibilityCriteria: Female candidate admitted to AICTE approved polytechnic institution for diploma
Family income not exceeding ₹8.00 Lakh per annum
Maximum two girls per family
scholarships.selectionMethod: Merit list based on 10th standard percentage against state polytechnic quotas
scholarships.disbursementMode: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to bank account
scholarships.applicationProcedure: Apply on NSP portal (scholarships.gov.in) with OTR and institute verification.

faqs.q: What is the duration for diploma students?
faqs.a: Maximum 3 years for first year students, and maximum 2 years for lateral entry students.

scholarships.name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
scholarships.ministry: Ministry of Education (Dept of Higher Education)
scholarships.targetGroup: Meritorious Class 12th passouts (above 80th percentile) from State & Central Boards
scholarships.domicileRequirement: Pan India (allocated across State Education Boards by population)
keyBenefits: Financial assistance to meet day-to-day higher education expenses
Graduation rate: ₹12,000 per annum for the first 3 years
Post-Graduation rate: ₹20,000 per annum (and for 4th/5th year of integrated/professional courses)
Total of 82,000 fresh scholarships awarded annually nationwide
eligibilityCriteria: Applicant must be in the top 20th percentile list of the concerned Class 12 Board examination
Pursuing regular full-time degree course (distance/correspondence or diploma NOT eligible)
Gross parental/family annual income up to ₹4.50 Lakh
Not receiving any other central or state fee waiver/scholarship
requiredDocuments: Class 12th Board marksheet and Roll Number matching NSP records
scholarships.selectionMethod: State Board quota distribution in stream ratio 3:3:1 (Science:Humanities:Commerce) with 50% reservation for girls and statutory SC (15%), ST (7.5%), OBC (27%) reservations
scholarships.disbursementMode: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into student’s Aadhaar-seeded account via PFMS
scholarships.applicationProcedure: Online submission on NSP (scholarships.gov.in) using One-Time Registration (OTR) and e-KYC.

faqs.q: Are students taking a drop year after 12th eligible?
faqs.a: No. Students who had taken a gap/drop after 12th class are not eligible for fresh PM-USP CSSS scholarships.
Securing at least 50% marks in annual exam and maintaining minimum 75% attendance without disciplinary complaints.

scholarships.name: Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for Ministry of Railways (RPF/RPSF)
scholarships.targetGroup: Dependent wards of serving or retired RPF / RPSF personnel
scholarships.familyIncomeCapFormatted: No income ceiling (service rank priority applies)
keyBenefits: Encourages higher technical & professional education for children of Railway Protection Force personnel
Female wards: ₹3,000 per month (disbursed annually as ₹36,000)
Male wards: ₹2,500 per month (disbursed annually as ₹30,000)
Duration: 2 to 5 years according to course duration approved by regulatory body
eligibilityCriteria: Dependent son/daughter of serving/retired RPF/RPSF personnel (including death during service)
Maximum two children of an RPF/RPSF personnel can avail simultaneously
Admitted to approved professional/technical courses (B.Tech, MBBS, BDS, MBA, MCA, etc.)
Minimum 60% marks in 10+2 or diploma
requiredDocuments: Serving Certificate or Discharge Certificate of parent in RPF/RPSF
Admission fee receipt & Bonafide certificate from recognized college
scholarships.selectionMethod: Order of preference based on category: Category I (Martyrs) to Category VII (Serving personnel)
scholarships.disbursementMode: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into student account
scholarships.applicationProcedure: Online registration on National Scholarship Portal (www.scholarships.gov.in).

faqs.q: Can lateral entry B.Tech students apply?
faqs.a: Yes, students entering 2nd year B.Tech after polytechnic can apply if they obtained at least 60% marks in polytechnic.

scholarships.name: National Scholarship for Post Graduate Studies
scholarships.targetGroup: Students admitted to 1st year full-time Post-Graduate programs in Indian Universities/Colleges
scholarships.amountSubtitle: ₹15,000 per month for 10 months each academic year (Total 20 months)
keyBenefits: Stipend of ₹15,000 per month for 10 months in each year of PG study (Total ₹3,00,000 over 2 years)
Total 10,000 slots earmarked per annum for PG scholars across India
Supports Master of Arts, Sciences, Commerce, Engineering, and Management
eligibilityCriteria: Admitted in 1st year of regular full-time Master degree program in recognized university/college
Student should not be receiving any other fellowship, stipend or salary
Distance, part-time or private mode courses are not eligible
requiredDocuments: University Post-Graduate admission proof & AISHE code
scholarships.selectionMethod: National merit list prepared on the basis of marks scored in qualifying graduation examination with reservation quotas
scholarships.disbursementMode: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) through PFMS on monthly/quarterly schedule
scholarships.applicationProcedure: Online application through National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

faqs.q: How many scholarships are available under this UGC scheme?
faqs.a: A total of 10,000 fresh PG scholarships are awarded annually.

scholarships.name: Financial Support to the Students of NER for Higher Professional Courses (NEC Stipend)
scholarships.ministry: Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region (DoNER) / NEC
scholarships.targetGroup: Permanent residents of North Eastern Region pursuing professional diploma, degree, PG, or M.Phil/Ph.D
scholarships.amountSubtitle: Annual stipend + initial book grant based on course level
scholarships.domicileRequirement: Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, or Tripura
keyBenefits: Financial support for students of North Eastern States studying within or outside the region
Diploma level: ₹20,000/year; Degree level: ₹22,000/year; PG level: ₹25,000/year; M.Phil/Ph.D: ₹30,000/year
One-time book grant sanctioned at commencement of course
eligibilityCriteria: Permanent resident of any of the 8 North Eastern States
Admitted to a recognized institution for approved technical or professional courses
Parental annual income from all sources not exceeding ₹8.00 Lakh
requiredDocuments: Permanent Resident Certificate (PRC) from Deputy Commissioner / District Magistrate
Admission proof and marksheet of qualifying examination
scholarships.selectionMethod: Merit list prepared state-wise based on entrance exam or qualifying exam marks
scholarships.disbursementMode: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) via PFMS to Aadhaar seeded bank account
scholarships.applicationProcedure: Online registration on NSP choosing DoNER - NEC Stipend scheme.

faqs.q: Can a student studying outside the North East apply for NEC Stipend?
faqs.a: Yes, as long as the student is a permanent resident of one of the 8 NE states and enrolled in a recognized institution anywhere in India.
